描述_EN: although this bottle is cream-coloured rather than white it would have been produced in the same kilns that specialized in high-fired white wares. in the tang dynasty (618-907) daily utensils were usually made of stoneware and goods for burial were made of earthenware.
描述_ZN: 虽然这个瓶子是乳白色的，而不是白色的，但它应该是在专门生产高烧白器的同一窑炉中生产的。 在唐代（618-907），日常用具通常由石器制成，而埋葬物品则由陶器制成。
